name: Tempo
description: A bold, stark athletic / sportswear storefront LOOK — a campaign-driven home with an auto-advancing hero carousel, a team-colorway scroller, category tiles, a live best-sellers grid, a membership band and a mega footer, plus a Shop catalog page, a Club membership page, Our Story, Help, a News index, enriched product and article templates, a matching black-on-white theme, and brand-voiced welcome + new-drops emails. The look, not the goods: it ships no catalog of its own, so the product grids fill with your own products (or industry sample data) and are empty until then. Installs as a draft for the tenant to review, customize, and publish.
